captions.detailed: A single-speed urban bicycle crankset featuring a black cylindrical bottom-bracket shell, two matching black crank arms, a metallic silver-grey chainring with radial spokes, and two rectangular grey platform pedals. The crank arms are positioned 180 degrees apart, each connected to a pedal via a silver axle. The bottom-bracket spindle, crank arms, and chainring rotate continuously as a single unit, while each pedal rotates independently and continuously around its axle.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery Python script for a single-speed urban bicycle crankset. The assembly must include a black bottom-bracket shell, a spoked metallic chainring, two black crank arms set at 180 degrees, and two grey platform pedals. Ensure continuous rotational joints are modeled for the spindle/crank assembly and for each of the pedals on their axles.
captions.factory: The code constructs the bottom-bracket shell using a cylinder primitive. The rotating crank assembly is defined as a part containing a spindle cylinder, a chainring (created with a central disc, spokes, and outer ring), and two crank arms modeled by lofting or combining cylinders. Each pedal is constructed from a box primitive representing the platform, combined with a cylindrical axle. Three continuous articulations are defined: one for the spindle/crank assembly relative to the shell, and two for the left and right pedals relative to their respective crank arms.
